title.narrative: Improved access to clean urban transport and the capacity and efficiency of public transport services

description.narrative: The Company will be able to increase the efficiency of trolleybus operations through improved accessibility, modernised infrastructure, increased average service speeds and decreased maintenance intensity and costs.

comment.narrative: The first disbursement to cover an advance payment under the trolleybus contract was planned on the 28th of February 2022 but eventually it has been cancelled by the Bank due to start of the war and attack on the City. Currently the City is occupied by Russian forces therefore further implementation of the Kherson Trolleybus Subproject is not possible under the circumstances. At this stage there are a lot of uncertainties with regard to the Citys nearest future. Partial repurposing should be considered.
